note: PRD v0.4 ACT-11a, architecture §4.6. Nothing here is set from a measurement yet. Strategy order, the per-app synthetic-copy and quiescence flags and the autoAppear decisions are M0 spike 3's output, and which axEnable attribute an app answers to is spike 4's; the axEnable kinds below are the platform's convention for the app's family (Electron takes AXManualAccessibility, Chromium takes AXEnhancedUserInterface) and are provisional until spike 4 runs. The copiesLineWhenEmpty flags are not provisional: ACT-11a names those apps itself, and the flag only ever takes synthetic copy away. expectedCopyDelta is how far one ⌘C may move the pasteboard's change count (ACT-10e); one clear and one write is what nearly every app does, and the apps that do otherwise are M0 spike 6's unrun 'live' option to find — an empty range (minimum above maximum) is how an app is told never to be asked. Bundle identifiers are those of Packages/PappuKit/Sources/PappuHarness/Resources/app-matrix.json, where most are unverified; the JetBrains prefix is from memory and unverified.
